nodes.svg_description: Flat vector easel centered on the canvas in terracotta (#c95f3b) holding a pale pink poster/board (#efb0a6). The easel includes: two wide, rounded-corner legs splayed outward; a narrow vertical center support; a horizontal shelf bar across the bottom edge of the board (in front of it); a horizontal top clamp bar overlapping the top edge of the board (in front); and a small, rounded triangular head piece above the clamp with a circular hole punched through (the hole shows the background color #f7dcb8). The legs and center support sit behind the pink board; the clamp and shelf sit in front. All shapes are simple, solid fills without strokes or shadows.
